_doc: The storefront layer (world v44) — the literal copy a camera reads on every door-having venue: fascia sign text, window glass lines, menu/chalk board, sidewalk A-frame, flyer-board postings, neon, and the closed-door note. Machine source for world/storefront.html (inline STO mirror) and the future art-track signage pass. Rules: parody names only (businesses.md §4); game-dollar prices only — never credits, never USD; every conditional line is a CONDITION the world may satisfy, never a scheduled script. Storefronts exist only for venues with a door: tiers anchor + street. Offstage organizations and reserved names carry none — enforced by audit.js biz gate.
